summary: Iteration 12 validated the lojista 'Remover entregador' (delete courier link) fix end-to-end. Backend 6/6 tests passing (test_iter12_courier_remove.py): register a TEST courier -> POST /api/my/couriers/invite -> courier accepts via /courier/me/invites/{id}/respond -> GET /api/my/couriers contains courier with status='accepted' -> DELETE /api/my/couriers/{courier_id} returns {ok:true} -> GET /api/my/couriers no longer contains that id. Idempotent second DELETE still returns ok:true. Auth-role checks: cliente token -> 403, no token -> 401. Frontend UI verified on mobile viewport (390x844): demo lojista login (sign-in-demo-lojista + sign-in-submit) -> dashboard -> dash-goto-couriers -> couriers list shows 8 rows including 'TEST_UIRemove Alpha' (ZF-MNUGX). Tapping courier-remove-<id> opens courier-remove-modal. Tapping courier-remove-cancel closes modal and keeps the row. Tapping courier-remove-confirm triggers DELETE /api/my/couriers/{id}, closes the modal, reloads list, and the row disappears (8 -> 7 rows). Bug (Alert.alert 3-buttons not firing on RN Web) is fixed via in-app Modal.
action_items: None for this bug. Optional cleanup: consider deleting seeded/leftover TEST_* couriers from earlier iterations (Rafael/Carlos/TEST_Courier_* etc.) to keep the lojista list tidy in future demos.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(lojista)/couriers.tsx (173 lines): clean and focused; state machine (confirm/removing) is correct; disabled during removing prevents double-tap.
doRemove() calls load() after successful DELETE which refetches /my/couriers — good; UI reflects removal deterministically instead of local splice.

Backend DELETE /api/my/couriers/{courier_id} uses delete_one and returns {ok:true} even when nothing matched — this is idempotent-friendly but does not distinguish 'not found'; acceptable for this UX (frontend doesn't need to differentiate).

Console warnings persist: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' — RN Web deprecations, non-blocking; already noted in prior iterations.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: on React Native Web, Alert.alert() with more than 2 buttons does not render a usable confirmation dialog and its onPress callbacks are never invoked, so tapping the trash icon appeared to do nothing. Fix (verified): in /app/frontend/app/(lojista)/couriers.tsx the trash press now calls setConfirm(courier) which opens an in-app <Modal testID='courier-remove-modal'> containing 'Cancelar' (courier-remove-cancel -> setConfirm(null)) and 'Remover' (courier-remove-confirm -> doRemove -> api.removeCourierLink(id) -> DELETE /api/my/couriers/{id} -> setConfirm(null) + load()). Verified in UI: modal opens, Cancel preserves the row, Confirm removes the row (list count decreases and DELETE succeeds).
